segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: We're still figuring out how to talk about what we do without sounding like every other analytics vendor.

segments.speaker: Sam Ortiz
segments.text: Our primary goal this year is to increase qualified opportunities from the website, not just traffic.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: The homepage feels dated, and sales keeps sending people to PDFs because the site doesn't explain the offer well.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Positioning is a significant concern. Prospects ask what makes us different and we don't have a clean answer.

segments.speaker: Sam Ortiz
segments.text: We need marketing to update pages without opening tickets every time. That dependency is killing campaign speed.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Budget is still forming, but leadership wants to see a scoped phase-one before committing to a full rebuild.

segments.speaker: Sam Ortiz
segments.text: Ideal timeline would be discovery this quarter and something live before our spring launch window.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: I'm the economic buyer. Sam owns day-to-day marketing operations and will be the main collaborator.
